en-US.title: AFOMA Marketplace
en-US.subtitle: Handmade & ethical shopping
en-US.promoText: Shop handmade goods from artisans worldwide. Browse, checkout securely, track orders, and manage your account from your phone.
en-US.description:
AFOMA Marketplace connects you with independent makers and ethical brands—especially artisans in emerging markets. Discover authentic handmade products, support creative entrepreneurs, and shop with confidence.

SHOP
• Home, categories, and search
• Product and service listings with photos, variations, and reviews
• Seller shops and featured collections

CHECKOUT & ORDERS
• Cart, shipping quotes, and promo codes
• Secure payments (card, PayPal, and regional options where enabled)
• Order history and delivery details

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Email sign-in with one-time passcode verification
• Saved addresses, notifications, and referral earnings
• Buyer–seller messages with report and block tools
• Delete your account in-app (Account → Account details)

FOR SELLERS
• Seller dashboard, listings, orders, shipping, coupons, and earnings
• Create and manage products and services (including photo uploads)

Privacy policy: https://afomamarketplace.com/privacy-policy
Terms: https://afomamarketplace.com/terms-conditions
Support: contact@afoma.io
en-US.releaseNotes: Welcome to AFOMA Marketplace on mobile—browse, checkout, and manage your account with the same trusted marketplace experience as the web.

review.notes:
AFOMA Marketplace — App Review guide
Support during review: +13652936113 / contact@afoma.io
Screen recording (iPhone, latest iOS): {{VIDEO_URL}}

SIGN-IN (email + one-time code, no password)
Buyer: {{BUYER_EMAIL}}  Seller: {{SELLER_EMAIL}}
Code for both review accounts: {{CODE}} (fixed for these accounts; no email needed)
Account tab → Log in → enter email → enter the code.

1. PURPOSE & AUDIENCE
AFOMA is a marketplace where independent makers and small businesses (mainly in Nigeria) sell handmade goods, local foods, beauty products and in-person beauty/wellness services to adult shoppers. It gives small sellers a storefront, orders and payouts without their own website.

2. MAIN FLOWS
Buyer: Home/Categories → product → Add to cart → Cart → Checkout → Payment screen → Account → My Orders.
Messages: Account → Messages → thread header: flag = Report user, ban icon = Block user.
Report content: product page → “Report this listing”; under any review → “Report”.
Seller (sign out, log in with seller email): Account → Seller → Dashboard, Listing Management, Orders, Earnings, Subscription & Plan (read-only).
Delete account: Account → Account details → Delete account (please use a new test account, not the demo accounts).

3. PAYMENTS (LIVE)
This is the production build: payments are real. Please go through checkout up to the payment screen; there is no need to complete a payment.{{COUPON_NOTE}}
In-app purchases are only for physical goods and in-person services sold by third-party sellers, paid via Stripe (card/Apple Pay), PayPal or Korapay. No digital goods are sold in the app. Seller plans are business tools managed on our website; the app has no plan purchase, prices or links for them.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
Stripe, PayPal, Korapay (payments); Mailjet (email); Firebase/APNs via Expo (push); our own Node.js API and Socket.IO chat; Sentry (crash reports); Anthropic Claude API (optional AI help drafting seller listing text).

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
Features are the same everywhere. Prices show in the user's local currency. Users paying in African currencies (NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, etc.) check out with Korapay instead of Stripe. Selling is currently open to Nigeria-based sellers.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
Not a regulated-industry app. Sellers are independent third parties bound by our Terms (https://afomamarketplace.com/terms-conditions); listings are moderated and can be reported.
